gen-gf-tektur-gf-mukta-malar: Mukta Malar reads as a plain sans with short ascenders, friendly and unfussy. Tektur is the one with the nerve, its curves as heavy as its stems like bent cord, while the body simply gets on with the talking.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-mukta-vaani: Marker-blunt and a bit mechanical, Tektur rounds off every stroke end to end. And Mukta Vaani, with its high-waisted lowercase, sits underneath as a modern sans that lets the heading do the shouting.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-narnoor: Tektur looks traced with a marker, every curve left generously open at the terminals. And Narnoor handles the sustained reading, a sans with short ascenders over big bowls that keeps the attention on the words.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-display: Noto Sans Display reads as an approachable sans-serif with a big, tall middle zone in every word. And Tektur, cut to one width throughout, is what gives the pair its quirky, expressive edge.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-play: Tektur hums across the line in a soft, featureless way, its outsized lowercase doing the showing off. But Play brings a restrained thick-thin rhythm, quietly better at carrying the actual sentences.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-port-lligat-sans: Wiry, odd and eye-catching, Tektur gives every curve the heft of a straight stem. Port Lligat Sans, a sans-serif with unfinished bowls and tightly packed characters, is the better hand at carrying the running text.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-ramabhadra: Tektur draws tubular, wire-like letterforms with outsized lowercase and wide-open curve endings. And Ramabhadra, a sans with a prominent x-height, would hold up at a modest size beneath a much bigger heading.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-rambla: Cord-thick curves meet small letters that nearly match capitals in height, which gives Tektur and Rambla a lively, lopsided charm. And Rambla, a plain sans, stays easy company over a long passage.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-recursive: Quirky meets friendly here, with Tektur's pipe-cleaner strokes up top and a modern plain sans below. Recursive keeps its thickness constant in every direction, with a tall mean line that makes long reading go smoothly.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-roboto-condensed: Tektur's pipe-cleaner strokes and outsized lowercase give it a look nothing else on the page can match. Roboto Condensed packs tight and glides like wire, so the pair feels sharp and compact.
